use default

shell_sort[T: Ghul.Comparable[T]](values: LIST[T]) is
    let gap mut = values.count / 2

    while gap > 0 do
        for i in gap..values.count do
            let temp = values[i]
            let j mut = i

            while j >= gap /\ values[j - gap] > temp do
                values[j] = values[j - gap]
                j = j - gap
            od

            values[j] = temp
        od

        gap = gap / 2
    od
si

let numbers = LIST([5, 3, 8, 1, 9, 2, 7])

shell_sort(numbers)

write_line(numbers |> join(", "))

let words = LIST(["pear", "apple", "quince", "banana"])

shell_sort(words)

write_line(words |> join(", "))
